entrypoints.source: editor snapshot cancel or user delete
entrypoints.sink: itineraries update/delete plus local cache removal
entrypoints.fallback: local snapshot restore or logged remote-delete failure

entrypoints.sink: legacy direct-provider HTTP and broad JSON parsing

entrypoints.source: diary forms, local caches, current user, and public feed

entrypoints.source: diary generate, text polish, and copilot prompts with diary JSON
